verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no account-level data export, bulk download of generation history, prompt or project export, or account-deletion and portability path. The 16-bit EXR export ([luma-docs-13], [luma-docs-16]) is a render output format for compositing individual generations. That is an adjacent feature, not a capability for exporting all of a user's data and leaving.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
